fact: The party enters a vast cavern reeking of brimstone and fungi, where flickering campfires illuminate a raised platform.
source_quote: You enter a large cavern filled with the acrid stench of brimstone and fungi. Flickering campfires illuminate a raised platform at the center
subject: ritual cavern

fact: Five Derro cultists stand on the raised platform chanting in a discordant, maddening chorus.
source_quote: where five Derro chant in a discordant, maddening chorus
subject: Derro cultists

fact: A grotesque stone giant statue barely two feet tall sits at the heart of the ritual circle.
source_quote: At the heart of the ritual stood a grotesque stone giant statue, barely two feet tall
subject: stone giant statue

fact: A second head sprouts from the statue's neck and reshapes itself with each verse of the ritual.
source_quote: a lump sprouts from the statue's neck, enlarging and reshaping itself with each unholy verse to take the form of a second head
subject: statue head sprouting

fact: A restless death dog paces in a cage near the platform's edge.
source_quote: A restless death dog paced in a cage near the platform's edge
subject: death dog

fact: A nervous Derro handler watches over the caged death dog.
source_quote: watched over by a nervous Derro handler
subject: Derro handler

fact: Grula-Munga, a massive female ettin, lurks silently in a fungal alcove observing the ritual.
source_quote: A massive female ettin named Grula-Munga lurked silently in a fungal alcove, observing the proceedings
subject: Grula-Munga

fact: This cult is confirmed to be the same group behind the demonic infusion of the dragon egg.
source_quote: they confirmed this was the same cult behind the demonic infusion of the dragon egg
subject: Demogorgon cult

fact: Daz rolls a 14 on an Arcana check, failing to meet the needed 16 for a full understanding of the ritual.
source_quote: Daz's arcana check (14, against a needed 16) ... fell short of the full picture
subject: Daz arcana check

fact: Gyrgum rolls a 10 on his first Religion check, which falls short of grasping the full ritual.
source_quote: Gyrgum's first religion check (10) both fell short of the full picture
subject: Gyrgum first religion check

fact: Narrak is the lead spellcaster and a member of the Council of Savants.
source_quote: Narrak, the lead spellcaster, is a member of the Council of Savants
subject: Narrak

fact: The heretical texts recovered by the party are evidence sufficient to bring down the entire Council of Savants.
source_quote: The heretical texts they had already recovered were damning enough to bring down the entire Council for all time
subject: Council of Savants

fact: The party has already recovered a trove of heretical Demogorgon texts.
source_quote: They had already recovered a trove of heretical Demogorgon texts
subject: heretical texts

fact: Narrak chants a rhyme invoking Demogorgon and promising more heads for grafting.
source_quote: Hear me, you two-headed fools, as madness flows, our city drools. For Demogorgon, the city will burn. More heads for grafting more for the pile
subject: Narrak chanting

fact: The ritual is identified as the likely cause of the two-headed stone giant that rampaged through the market four days ago.
source_quote: this ritual was likely the cause of the two-headed stone giant that had rampaged through the market only four days earlier in game time
subject: market giant attack

fact: Stonespeaker Hgraam sensed 'something evil is going on' regarding the giant attacks.
source_quote: Hgraam had sensed 'something evil is going on'
subject: Stonespeaker Hgraam

fact: Gyrgum rolls a 21 on a second Religion check, becoming inspired by Bahamut.
source_quote: On a second religion roll of 21, Gyrgum was inspired by Bahamut
subject: Gyrgum second religion check

fact: Gyrgum surmises that bringing a corrupted statue to Stonespeaker Hgraam might allow him to reverse the curse afflicting his people.
source_quote: bringing one of the corrupted statues to Stonespeaker Hgraam might allow him to reverse the curse afflicting his people
subject: reversing the curse

fact: Stonespeaker Hgraam is a location or entity associated with stone giants and potentially reversing their curse.
source_quote: bringing one of the corrupted statues to Stonespeaker Hgraam might allow him to reverse the curse afflicting his people
subject: Stonespeaker Hgraam

fact: Thorin is a lover of giants who would want to stop cultists manipulating giant physiology.
source_quote: Thorin, a lover of giants, would want to put a stop to cultists manipulating giant physiology
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum admits he is basically out of spells.
source_quote: Gyrgum admitted he was "basically out of spells"
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz is out of first-level spells.
source_quote: Daz was out of first-level spells
subject: Daz

fact: The ordinary Derro cultists have approximately 13 hit points.
source_quote: the ordinary Derro had around 13 hit points
subject: ordinary Derro

fact: Two tougher Derro cultists, marked with red dots, have 27 hit points.
source_quote: two tougher ones (marked with red dots) have 27
subject: tougher Derro

fact: Narrak the spellcaster has 70 hit points.
source_quote: Narrak himself had 70
subject: Narrak

fact: The party learns the stone giant statues are two-foot tall miniatures weighing 100 pounds.
source_quote: the DM clarified they were two-foot, 100-pound miniatures
subject: statue size clarification

fact: The stone giant statues serve as focal points for the curse affecting real stone giants.
source_quote: the statue is a focal point for the curse ... serving as focal points for the curse affecting real stone giants
subject: stone giant statues

fact: Locked chests are scattered about the cavern, hinting at valuable treasures.
source_quote: The locked chests scattered about the cavern hinted at valuable treasures
subject: locked chests

fact: The party decides to retreat to a safer location to recover magical strength before confronting the cultists.
source_quote: The party decides to retreat to a safer location to recover their magical strength before confronting the cultists
subject: party retreat

fact: The party pins Narrak's location on their map.
source_quote: and pins Narrak's location on the map
subject: Narrak location pinned

fact: The market attack by the two-headed stone giant occurred four days prior to this encounter.
source_quote: only four days earlier in game time
subject: elapsed time
